# ParticleBlend

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · enum

```csharp
public enum ParticleBlend
```

How particles combine with what's behind them.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="alpha"></a>`Alpha` | Particles cover what's behind them by their opacity. |
| <a name="additive"></a>`Additive` | Particles add their color to what's behind them, so overlapping particles glow. |
